title: It may rain diamonds inside Neptune and Uranus
body: At the pressures deep inside ice giants, methane is thought to be squeezed until carbon separates as diamond, sinking slowly through the mantle. Laboratory laser-shock experiments have produced nanodiamonds from plastics under similar conditions, backing the idea. The solar system's most extravagant weather is permanently hidden under blue haze.
source_hint: Kraus et al., Nature Astronomy (2017), laser shock experiments
